title: Halden: RHR cooling chain
description: A finite cooling-path exercise on the fictional current four-loop PWR. Unit 2 starts at the standard full-power operating point. Ten seconds in, an explicit primary boundary break fills the containment sump and depressurizes the primary circuit. Use the RHR-1 task to establish actual cooled low-head injection through RHR, component cooling water and service water. This demonstrates measured finite heat transport; it does not qualify sump suction, source transfer, long-term recirculation, shutdown cooling or recovery of the plant.
objectives: Follow the physical response to the primary release and wait for actual sump inventory and shutdown indications.
Run RHR-1 on Unit 2, using achieved flow, both exchanger heat transfers and delivered injection to verify the represented chain.
Compare the response when a CCW or service-water train is stopped; finite CCW storage cannot replace continuing terminal heat rejection.

environment.model: Fictional finite RHR cooling-chain exercise; no real plant operating qualification

guidance.title: RHR cooling chain
guidance.message: A primary release is scheduled at +10 s. Use Guide, inspect actual sump and shutdown feedback, then request RHR-1 for Unit 2 if an Assistant provider is available. Inspect achieved flow and both heat-transfer paths through the admitted procedure criteria before handing off continuing duties.

guide.title: Trace the RHR cooling chain
guide.description: Supervised process-model exercise using RHR-1; it is not an operational qualification.

steps.title: Identify Unit 2
steps.instruction: Locate the exact Unit 2 object and open its model-backed display. Read the starting state and current time before the scripted event.

steps.title: Advance to the initiating event
steps.instruction: Advance the shared Run ten simulation seconds. Inspect the admitted cue and actual feedback; a failed or uncertain cue is not a completed initiating event.

steps.title: Ask the Assistant
steps.instruction: Review the target and explicitly send or edit this request. Inspect the actual RHR-1 execution and its admitted criteria. If no provider is available, Skip the response task and inspect the same model and procedure evidence manually.

action.text: Run RHR-1 for Halden Unit 2 using the admitted procedure and report actual flow, both heat-transfer paths, evidence times and continuing duties.

steps.title: Inspect achieved response
steps.instruction: Verify achieved RHR flow and heat transfer through CCW to service water; a pump start or valve command does not establish heat removal.

steps.title: Keep the comparison independent
steps.instruction: Copy the Run before trying loss of cooling, a wrong order or source restoration. Confirm the new Run identity and checkpoint. Compare achieved response at equivalent times; never reset this Run merely to make a guide fit.

steps.title: Choose a continuing duty
steps.instruction: Inspect the remaining criteria, unresolved alarms and sustaining conditions. Name who or what will monitor the continuing duty. Continue acknowledges the handoff discussion; it does not close a procedure or prove continuing performance.

steps.title: Continue exploring
steps.instruction: This guide is finished. The same Run remains available. Pause or stop guidance whenever you wish; those controls do not pause the shared simulation. Copy the Run before trying a different intervention. Acknowledgements record your choice to continue, not a qualification.
